Ninos Sports — Shopify Migration Proposal

Client: Ninos Sports (eshop.ninos-sports.com), dive, snorkeling, freediving and fishing gear, Limassol, Cyprus
Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup  ·  Date: November 25, 2026
$1,350Option 1 — 45hReplicate + improvements (§4)
$1,950Option 2 — 65hRedesign: 20h design + 45h build (§4)
11–14Working days from kick-off to ready-to-launch, plus your feedback time (§6)

You want to move the Ninos Sports eShop from nopCommerce to Shopify. This proposal shows what we found on the current site, two ways to rebuild it (keep the current look with improvements, or a new design), and the cost and timeline for each. Your products, customers and orders move with LitExtension, our sister company.

1

Why LitOS

One teamLitOS and LitExtension are part of the same company, LitGroup. The people moving your data and the people building your store work together, so your data is mapped to how your theme displays it, in the admin and on the storefront.
2

What we found on the current site

AreaWhat we see todayWhat we'd do
MenuGoes 4 levels deep (Scuba › Divewear › Wetsuits › 5.0mm)Restructure to Shopify's 3 levels (§2.1)
Homepage heroImage only: no title, button or linkAdd a link, or a title and button (§2.2)
Categories on homepageNone; categories are only in the menuAdd a category section (§2.2)
Scubapro bannerImage only, no linkAdd a title and button (§2.3)
Collection pageNo filter by price or brandAdd price, brand and other filters (§2.4)
Product pageNo stock status, delivery info or wishlist button; Google+ share button (the service closed in 2019)Clearer layout (§2.5)
WishlistYes, from the headerKeep it (§3)

Images tagged Today are from your current site. Images tagged Mock-up are illustrations of the proposed change; they are not on your site today.

2.1 Menu

TodayScuba › Divewear › Wetsuits › thickness is 4 levels. Shopify menus allow 3.

The products and categories can all move; only the menu needs to be flatter. For example, the wetsuit thicknesses can become a filter or links on the "Wetsuits" page. You decide the new menu (§7); we set it up.

2.2 Homepage hero and categories

Mock-upNot your current site. Your hero today is an image with no text or link. Look at the title, short line and two buttons that send shoppers straight to a category.

At minimum we link the hero to a page. Better: a title and button like the mock-up. Below it we add a category section (Scuba, Snorkeling & Swimming, Freediving & Spearfishing, Fishing) so shoppers reach a category in one tap.

2.3 Scubapro banner

TodayThe banner has no text or link of its own. We'd add a title and button, as in the hero, linking to the Scubapro products.

2.4 Collection page

We add filters for price, brand, availability and product type with Shopify's free Search & Discovery app. More filters (size, wetsuit thickness) are possible if that data is on the products; see §7.

2.5 Product page

Today then Mock-upTop: your current page. Bottom: an illustration, not your current site. Look at the title and price at the top, stock status, the wishlist heart next to "Add to cart", and short rows for delivery, payment and warranty. The texts in these rows ("ships from Limassol", "1–2 working days") are placeholders for you to confirm (§7).

5

Your data, customers and Google rankings

Your concernHow it's handled
Google rankingsLitExtension's 301 redirect option sends every old product and category URL to its new page. It's a paid option when you buy the migration; we recommend it, otherwise these redirects are made by hand. For pages, blog posts, SEO titles and the new sitemap, we give you a step-by-step guide. Some movement in rankings in the first weeks is normal.
Orders during the moveYour current site stays live until you switch the domain. Just before launch, LitExtension moves the orders, customers and products added in the meantime.
Wrong or missing dataWe check the migrated data in the admin and on the storefront, and work with LitExtension to correct anything that's wrong or missing.
Customer loginsPasswords can't be moved to Shopify. Customers sign in with their email and a one-time code, with no password reset.

Open questions
